evidence.title: Chapter 5 - Modifications and Exceptions to Continuous Residence and Physical Presence
evidence.text:
(PDF)
, 25 I&N Dec. 369 (AAO 2010). The decision states that under
INA 316(b)
, a publicly held corporation may be deemed an “American firm or corporation” if the applicant establishes that the corporation is both incorporated and trades its stock exclusively on U.S. Stock Exchange markets. If the applicant is unable to meet this qualification, then he or she must meet the requirements under
Matter of Warrach (PDF)
, 17 I&N Dec. 285, 286-287 (Reg. Comm. 1979). USCIS then determines the nationality of the corporation by reviewing whether more than 50 percent is owned by U.S. citizens. The applicant must establish this by a preponderance of the evidence.
[^ 5]
See
INA 316(b)
and
INA 316(c)
. See
8 CFR 316.20
.
